rationale: The Stonepeak transaction remained signed and unclosed at the cutoff. Its true perimeter is the combined BMO Transportation and Vendor Finance businesses plus approximately C$14.5 billion of loans and leases. The business originates, services and remarkets equipment financing rather than operating transportation infrastructure, so it is outside the direct infrastructure-equity census. BMO remains the legal owner, and Stonepeak plus BMO's 19.9% rollover remain pending only.
recommendedChanges: Exclude the BMO Transportation Finance source holding from the PortCo census.
Do not create a company or active Stonepeak ownership period.
Retain an off-ledger pending transaction note identifying BMO as current owner and Stonepeak as signed pending incoming.
Use BMO Transportation and Vendor Finance as the resolved combined-business identity; preserve BMO Transportation Finance as a trade name.
Keep financed equipment, customers, receivables trusts, securitization SPVs, PGIM and BofA outside the ownership roster.
unresolvedQuestions: Newco name, Stonepeak fund and acquisition SPVs, price, syndication, management rollover, regulatory approvals, exact closing date and loan-versus-lease mix were not publicly disclosed.
